How do you catch a hoarder who never works? A VRF beacon draws 5% each epoch, and the drawn prove real work within 2 epochs.

What happens to those who miss the call? A jury of 7 verifies the proof; absence freezes rewards 6 epochs, a second miss slashes 50% of the stake.

So what does it cost? 1,000 clones lock 120,000; each round the ripple of draws climbs toward the summit, about 6,000 lost, while honest workers wait on the jetty, untouched.
